## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · p2 · 2026-11-16T08:04Z

⛔ Not a claim. Requested by eval#1 (mailbox comment 6910831001).

The maintainer ruled on 2026-11-16 (「点名单条就算确认」): when the user names a record and exactly one record matches, MCP `delete_record` deletes it (to the recycle bin) without a second question. It asks only when the name is ambiguous or the delete is bulk. Asking again today is what fails most in-chat writes in the eval runs, and it is the user-facing AI write path, so **p2**. The MCP door and its guidance are server work; the scenario half is #34341.

Backlog re-grade (p2 batch 3). It carries the maintainer's ruling 「点名单条就算确认」: when a user names one record to delete, the request is the confirmation, and the AI asks only when it is ambiguous. External agents asking twice for a named delete is a user-visible friction in the MCP focus theme, so **p1**.
